requests_per_minute.per: 60 seconds per key or account token
requests_per_minute.applies_to: Every /api/v2 route but the health checks, reads and writes together; a /bulk call is one request. Over it: 429 too_many_requests.

requests_per_minute_keyless.applies_to: A request with no key and no account token.

changes_head_free_per_minute.per: 60 seconds per key or account token
changes_head_free_per_minute.applies_to: GET /changes?head=true answered 304: given back to the request budget, up to this many.

server_busy_slots.applies_to: Requests in flight at once on every route but the health checks; one past them waits for a slot.

server_busy_wait_seconds.applies_to: How long a request waits for a slot before 503 server_busy.

request_body_bytes.applies_to: A request's body. Over it: 413 payload_too_large.

list_limit_max.applies_to: GET /{type} limit; a larger one is read as this.

search_limit_max.applies_to: GET /search limit; a larger one is read as this.

file_bytes.applies_to: A file kept on an element.

files_world_bytes.applies_to: All the files a world keeps, together.

file_tickets_per_day.applies_to: File upload tickets. Over it: 429 quota_exceeded.

mcp_read_file_bytes.applies_to: The text the MCP read_file tool returns in one call; past it the reply is cut there and marked truncated.

snapshot_world_bytes.applies_to: A world's daily file: a world whose file would be larger gets none, and its page says so.

image_bytes.applies_to: An image upload: the ticket's max_bytes, which the upload host holds it to.

image_account_bytes.applies_to: All the images an account has uploaded, together (the admin may raise one account's). At it: 403 storage_full.

image_tickets_per_day.applies_to: Image upload tickets. Over it: 429 quota_exceeded.

extensions_bytes.applies_to: An element's extension fields together, as compact UTF-8 JSON; the world's own store takes the same cap. Over it: 422.

client_name_chars.applies_to: The X-OW-Client header. A longer value is no name, never a refusal.

idempotency_key_seconds.applies_to: How long a key's first answer is kept and replayed.

proposal_reason_chars.applies_to: A keeper's reason, declining a proposal or reviewing an element.

proposal_expires_default_days.applies_to: A proposal sent with no expires.

proposals_marked_listed.applies_to: GET /world/proposals: the newest marked new elements it lists.

proposals_list_limit_default.applies_to: GET /world/proposals and GET /{type}/{id}/proposals with no limit.

link_expiry_days.applies_to: A link's days: one of these.

link_expiry_default_days.applies_to: A link sent with no days.

link_max_uses.applies_to: A person's or a player's link: how many people it lets in.

pending_invites.applies_to: Pending invites and unused person and player links, together.

agent_seats.applies_to: Agent seats and unused agent links, together.

signin_token_lifetime_max_hours.applies_to: A registered tool's own token lifetime.

signin_attempts.applies_to: POST /auth/token and the password sign-in, one count. Over it: 429 rate_limited.
